name: Lobster Thermidor
instructions: 1. Boil the lobster, remove the meat from the shell, and chop into bite-sized pieces; keep the shells intact for presentation.
2. Heat butter in a pan, sauté finely chopped shallots, garlic, and green chillies until translucent.
3. Add turmeric, black pepper, and curry leaves to infuse flavor.
4. Stir in flour to make a roux, then gradually add coconut cream and mustard powder, stirring until the sauce thickens.
5. Fold the lobster meat into the sauce and simmer for 2 minutes.
6. Fill the cleaned lobster shells with the mixture and top generously with grated cheese.
7. Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C until the top is bubbly and golden brown.
description: Lobster Thermidor in the Andaman Islands represents a unique fusion of French colonial culinary influence and the island's abundant marine resources. It is a signature luxury dish served in local high-end eateries, highlighting the freshness of local rock lobsters combined with the coastal staple of coconut cream.
